Messages.Author: Johann
Messages.Body:
Malkavian Prank [Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Master

Clan: Malkavian

Master.
Each {other} Methuselah holds between 1 and 4 pool in his or her hand.
Guess the amount of pool in each Methuselah's hand. Each time you
guess correctly, you gain that {much pool from his or her pool}. If
you guess incorrectly, that Methuselah gains that much pool from the
blood bank.

from what i understand, each other meth holds out 2-3 pool because the
card states: ...BETWEEN 1-4...that means 2-3 right? so if someone
plays a prank i can only hold out 2-3 pool not 1-4 pool as some
players are saying here in our local play group...need clarification
for an upcoming tourny thanks

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


BETWEEN doesn't inherently exclude the end values.
Each other Methuselah holds from 1 to 4 pool in her hand.

If it had meant 2-3, it would would've been written to say so ("holds
2 or 3 pool").

Anarch Troublemaker wrote:
>
> LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> schrieb in im Newsbeitrag:
> 3CE683DD...@white-wolf.com...
> > BETWEEN doesn't inherently exclude the end values.
> > Each other Methuselah holds from 1 to 4 pool in her hand.
> >
> in other languages like german it does.

BETWEEN is an English word. It means nothing in German, TTBOMK.

ZWISCHEN may indeed exclude the end points by convention in German;
I'll have to take your word on that.

That says nothing about what BETWEEN means, however. In English,
if one wishes to exclude the endpoints, one adds "exclusive" to
the construction ("inclusive" being the default).

For examples of BETWEEN usage (in English), see below:
